about_the_game:
About the Story

Miss Hedgehog has lived peacefully in a shared apartment for as long as she can remember.

But one day, everything she sees loses its color.

To reclaim what was lost, she dares to step outside and begin an adventure.

Yet each time she blinks, she wakes up in the same bed, in the same room, as if nothing ever happened.

Features

  • Simple controls with light puzzle elements

  • Hand-drawn visuals with no text or dialogue

  • Explore 10 unique scenes and meet 3 animal neighbors

  • A short, narrative experience that takes about 1 hour to complete

Why This Game Was Made

I Need To Leave is a personal, one-person project based on a true story.

“All good things must come to an end.”
But when it’s up to you to say goodbye, can you face it and let go?

This game is a farewell in the form of a quiet adventure.
For those stuck in emotional loops or unable to move on, I hope it offers a small, gentle push toward something new.

short_description: I Need To Leave is a point-and-click escape game. The door is never locked, yet you keep returning to where you started. Search for clues and find the right way to leave this shared apartment of anthropomorphic animals.
